{{Short description|Italian Augustinian friar and mathematician}}
[[File:Stefano da San Gregorio - Aritmetica pratica, 1642 - BEIC 4714882.tiff|thumb|''Aritmetica pratica'', title page]]

'''Stefano da San Gregorio''' was a [[17th-century]] [[Italians|Italian]] [[mathematician]] and [[theologian]] from the [[Discalced Augustinians|Order of Discalced Augustinians]].<ref>{{Cite book|first=Giangiuseppe|last=Origlia|title=Dizionario storico|volume=2|publisher=Benedetto Gessari|location=Napoli|year=1757|page=235|chapter=SANGREGORIO (Stefano)|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3wcVAAAAQAAJ&pg=PA235|language=it}}</ref>

* {{Cite book|title=De praecipuis iuris et iustitiae partibus|location=Ferrara|publisher=Franciscum Succium|year=1643|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=EJW_wgVXVMQC|language=la}}
* {{Cite book|title=De divinae pietatis vinculis|publisher=Francisci Vigoni|location=Milano|year=1668|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=y8VJAAAAcAAJ|language=la}}
